stay.nearest_base: Srinagar (Doodhpathri is about 42 to 45 km SW of Srinagar and 30 km from Budgam town per budgam.nic.in and the Draft Master Plan); most visitors do it as a day trip
stay.price_basis: No tariff found anywhere. JKTDC publishes no rates for huts on its site; its online booking widget (checked 12-13 Nov 2026) has no Doodhpathri city.
stay.notes: Lodging EXISTS but is government huts, not a private market. Evidence: budgam.nic.in/accommodation (page updated 4 Sep 2025): 'A number of Govt. run huts are available at Yousmarg and Doodhpathri', bookable via JKTDC, CEO Doodhpathri 01951-256294. Doodhpathri Development Authority page (budgam.nic.in/dda): a 'Budgeted Accommodation (T-20 building at Dodhpathri)' completed. Draft Master Plan Doodhpathri-2032 (Nov 2011): 3 prefab fibreglass double-bed tourist huts built in the main bowl, budget accommodation under construction. CAUTION: the jktdc.co.in/info.aspx?id=9 Doodhpathri page lists 'Deluxe 1 BHK Hut ... Yatri Niwas Dormitory', but that identical 7-item list is boilerplate repeated on every JKTDC destination page (Yusmarg, Sonamarg, Kokernag, Verinag, Achabal, Srinagar hotels), so it is not evidence of those huts by itself; the page also says there is no full-fledged market or hotel. No Doodhpathri listing on Cleartrip, Booking.com (search returns no match), MakeMyTrip, Kayak, Agoda or Holidify (Holidify has no hotels page). Private camps likely exist but none found.
